# Diagnostic safety audit

<!-- Generated by Tools/agent/DiagnosticRows.jet from Compiler/Prelude/Diagnostics.jet; do not edit. -->

An error refuses a program for one of two reasons. A soundness error stops a memory, type, aliasing or resource fault, or the loss of a guarantee such as a capability or what a reviewer reads. An opinion error refuses a program that would run safely, for clarity or style. A reason that begins `Finding:` records a row whose code or name does not match one meaning.

Each row states its class in `safety_class` and why in `safety_reason`. A soundness row also states its `expert_path`: the opt-in that reaches the same program, or `none:` and why nothing can.

Classified ranges: E00xx, E01xx, E02xx, E03xx, E04xx, E05xx, E06xx, E07xx, E08xx, E09xx, E10xx, E11xx, E12xx, E13xx, E14xx, E18xx, E20xx, E21xx, E22xx, E23xx, E24xx, E25xx, E26xx, E27xx, E28xx, E29xx, E30xx, E31xx, E32xx, E33xx, E34xx, E35xx, E36xx, E42xx, E-Axx, E-Cxx, E-Exx, E-Fxx, E-Mxx, E-Oxx, E-Sxx, E-Txx, E-Wxx, JT0xx, L11xx, R08xx. They hold 821 active error rows: 703 soundness and 118 opinion. The other ranges hold 0 active error rows with no class yet.

## Sealed floors

A sealed floor is a soundness error that no `#Unsafe` block or other opt-in lifts. Its site is the first compiler call that passes the code to a report, in sema when sema has one. A code no call passes shows the first line that quotes it: whole, at the head of a message, or in a runtime report's brackets.

## Sealed floors no source reports

These soundness rows have no expert path, but no line under Compiler, Core, Jetpack passes or quotes their code, so no program meets them today: they are the `UNREPORTED_CODES` of Tools/agent/DiagnosticRows.jet, a list that only shrinks. Each becomes a sealed floor once a report site names it, or is retired.

| Code | Type | Why no expert path reaches the program |
|---|---|---|
| E1278 | IncompleteActivationProof | the activation proof is completed first |
| E1279 | MissingVmProofTools | the pinned proof tools are installed |
| E1280 | MissingKernelPackage | the first-party kernel package is present |
| E1281 | MissingInitPackage | the first-party `systemd` package is present |
| E1282 | MissingBootArtifacts | the kernel package provides its boot artifacts |
| E1283 | MissingInitArtifacts | the init package provides its binary |
| E1284 | MissingKernelRecipe | the kernel package carries its source recipe |
| E1285 | VmProofNotRun | `jet os vm prove` runs first |
| E1286 | KernelBuildFailed | the source build succeeds |
| E1287 | MissingInstalledDisk | `jet os vm prove` installs and proves the disk first |
| E1288 | MissingDesktopPackage | the first-party desktop packages are present |
| E1289 | NixosImportFailed | the configuration uses the surface the importer reads |
| E1290 | FakeVmTools | the real VM tools are installed |
| E1291 | UnmappedNixosOption | the declaration uses options the backend maps |

## Every classified row

| Code | Type | Class | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| E-APP-TARGET-FEATURE | AppFeatureNotOnTarget | soundness | The resolved target does not support the feature, so the app would call something the target lacks. |
| E-ERR-PROPAGATE | BareQuestionMark | opinion | Fallible calls already propagate, so the bare `?` changes nothing, and Jet refuses it so every `?` adds context. |
| E-ERR-UNION | UnparenthesizedErrorUnion | opinion | `A \| B!` has one reading, marking only `B`, and Jet asks for parentheses so the contract reads as the union it means. |
| E-OSTARGET-BUILD-CONTEXT | OsDispatchSubjectMismatch | soundness | The dispatch folds only on `#build.target.os`, so another subject has no compile-time value to fold. |
| E-OSTARGET-DISPATCH-ARM | InvalidOsDispatchArm | soundness | Each arm gates code for one OS, so an arm that names no OS, or repeats one, has no one meaning. |
| E-OSTARGET-DISPATCH-EXHAUSTIVE | NonExhaustiveOsDispatch | soundness | A build for an uncovered OS would have no code for the dispatch. |
| E-OSTARGET-MIXED-AXIS | OsAndWebTargetConflict | soundness | The OS axis and the web axis exclude each other, so an item gated on both is in no build. |
| E-OSTARGET-UNMATCHED-CALL | OsGatedTypeUngatedUse | soundness | The gated impl exists only in that OS's build, so ungated code would call methods missing on every other platform. |
| E-SUBJECT-CALL | MemberShorthandAsValue | soundness | Member shorthand stands for a one-parameter callable, so where an ordinary value is expected it is a value of the wrong type. |
| E-SUBJECT-CALL-ARITY | MemberShorthandArity | soundness | Member shorthand supplies exactly one subject, so a callable with more parameters would get no values for the rest. |
| E-WEB-ABI-TYPE | WebBoundaryTypeNotAllowed | soundness | The type has no ABI-safe representation, so it has no defined form on the far side of the JS and Wasm boundary. |
| E-WEB-CROSS-PARTITION | WebPartitionCrossed | soundness | The JS and Wasm partitions are separate outputs, so a direct call across them has no target in the caller's output. |
| E-WEB-RUN | WebProgramRunNotSupported | soundness | A web-targeted program builds browser artifacts, so there is no native executable to run. |
| E-WEB-TARGET-BROWSER | WasmFunctionUsesBrowser | soundness | Wasm code has no browser APIs, so a Wasm-pinned function with the `Browser` effect has nothing to call. |
| E-WEB-UNSUPPORTED | WebConstructNotSupported | soundness | The web output cannot lower the construct, so the function has no web code. |
| E0001 | StrayCharacter | soundness | The character has no meaning in Jet, so the file is no program and nothing could run. |
| E0002 | UnterminatedText | soundness | Where the text ends is unknown, so the rest of the file has no meaning to run. |
| E0003 | InvalidStatement | soundness | The form is not a statement of the grammar, so there is no program to run. |
| E0029 | DuplicateAccessMarker | soundness | Two markers give one parameter two access modes, so callers and body could disagree about who may write it. |
| E0035 | InvalidEnumDiscriminant | soundness | The discriminant sets the enum's layout, and a value that is unknown or does not fit would corrupt it. |
| E0042 | MisplacedShebang | opinion | A later `#!` line could be ignored safely, and Jet refuses it so a pasted launch line is not silently dead. |
| E0047 | OptionalChainOnNonOptional | opinion | On a value that is never None, `?.` could act like `.` and run safely, so the refusal only flags a misleading spelling. |
| E0063 | CompileTimePrefixOnRule | opinion | The rule's meaning is clear, and the refusal teaches that applied rules are written with `#`. |
| E0064 | InvalidForeignBody | soundness | Without one raw foreign-source string there is no foreign code to compile or call. |
| E0067 | ReservedDunderName | soundness | A source `__name` can collide with a name the compiler, the debugger or the serializer generates. |
| E0072 | CollectingLoopNotFinite | soundness | The loop promises a finished List, and without a finite exit that value never exists. |
| E0073 | CollectingLoopMissingItem | soundness | A path that adds no item leaves the collected List without a value for that iteration. |
| E0074 | CollectingLoopItemMismatch | soundness | One List holds one element type, so mixed items would be read as the wrong type. |
| E0075 | CollectingLoopBreakPayload | soundness | The loop's value is the collected List, so a payload would give one exit two values of different types. |
| E0076 | LoopResultMismatch | soundness | A loop used as a value has one type, and an exit without that value would leave the result undefined. |
| E0078 | MissingExhaustionRoute | soundness | When the source ends without a matching `break`, the loop has no value to give. |
| E0079 | EffectLoopResultExit | opinion | The payload would only be dropped, and Jet asks for a value loop so the result is not silently lost. |
| E0080 | ArrowFunctionBody | opinion | The arrow body's meaning is clear, and Jet keeps one spelling: named function bodies sit in braces. |
| E0081 | MissingFunctionBody | soundness | A call to a function with no body has no code to run. |
| E0082 | MixedLogicWithoutParentheses | opinion | `&&` binds tighter than `\|\|`, so the program is defined, and the refusal only guards against a misread grouping. |
| E0083 | UnclosedDelimiter | soundness | Where the delimited part ends is unknown, so the rest of the file has no meaning to run. |
| E0084 | TextOnTripleQuoteLine | opinion | Text beside the quotes has a meaning a rule could pick, and Jet refuses it to keep block text layout clear. |
| E0085 | UnqualifiedLibraryMarker | opinion | A bare marker from another library could resolve when unique, and Jet asks for the library named so readers know where it comes from. |
| E0086 | AmbiguousMarker | soundness | The marker resolves to more than one declaration, so its meaning is ambiguous. |
| E0087 | MarkerLibraryCasing | opinion | The marker resolves the same in any casing, and Jet keeps one spelling for library parts. |
| E0088 | BidiControlInSource | soundness | A bidirectional control makes the code a reviewer reads differ from the code Jet compiles, so accepting it lets hidden code pass review. |
| E0101 | MissingRunFunction | soundness | With no `run` function and no top-level statements, the program has no entry point. |
| E0102 | UnknownFunction | soundness | The called function does not exist, so the call has no code to run. |
| E0103 | EmptyPrint | opinion | Printing nothing would run safely, and the refusal only flags a call that does nothing visible. |
| E0104 | ArgumentCountMismatch | soundness | An extra or missing argument leaves a parameter without a value or a value without a parameter. |
| E0105 | DuplicateDefinition | soundness | Two definitions under one name leave each call with two meanings. |
| E0106 | BuiltinRedefined | opinion | A local definition could shadow the built-in and run safely, and Jet refuses it so every reader means the same built-in. |
| E0107 | UnknownName | soundness | The name refers to nothing, so the program would read a value that does not exist. |
| E0108 | BindingTypeMismatch | soundness | The binding's value has the wrong type, so code reading it as the declared type would misread its bytes. |
| E0109 | OperatorTypeMismatch | soundness | No rule defines the operator for these operand types, so there is no operation to run. |
| E0110 | ConditionNotBool | soundness | A branch needs a Bool, and a value of another type has no defined truth value. |
| E0111 | ImmutableAssignment | soundness | Views and borrows rely on a `:` binding never changing, so a write could change bytes a reader holds. |
| E0112 | ValueTypeMismatch | soundness | The value has the wrong type for its site, so the receiver would misread it. |
| E0113 | ReturnTypeMismatch | soundness | Callers read the declared return type, so a value of another type would be misread. |
| E0114 | MissingBlockValue | soundness | A path that reaches the end without a value leaves the caller reading a value that was never made. |
| E0115 | LoopControlOutsideLoop | soundness | With no enclosing loop, `break` or `next` has nowhere to go. |
| E0116 | ValuelessCallUsedAsValue | soundness | The call returns no value, so using it as one would read a value that does not exist. |
| E0117 | DuplicateMapKey | opinion | A repeated key could keep the last value and run safely, and Jet refuses it because the first value is almost always a mistake. |
| E0118 | NameAlreadyTaken | opinion | A second binding could shadow the first and run safely, and Jet refuses it so each name refers to one thing. |
| E0119 | UnknownType | soundness | The named type or effect does not exist, so the program has no type to check or lay out. |
| E0120 | ReadOnlyValueNotOwned | soundness | Filling an owning destination from a read-only value would leave two owners of one resource. |
| E0121 | UseAfterMove | soundness | After a move the storage belongs to its new owner, so the old name would read or free it twice. |
| E0122 | ExplicitCopiesUnparsable | opinion | The formatter refuses to write a file it cannot parse; the program itself is left unchanged and still runs. |
| E0123 | InvalidLoopStride | opinion | A zero or negative stride would loop forever or not at all without faulting, and Jet refuses it as a likely mistake. |
| E0124 | BranchTypeMismatch | soundness | The `if` value has one type, so branches of different types would be misread by the code that uses it. |
| E0126 | DefaultReadsLaterParameter | soundness | A later parameter has no value yet when the default runs, so the default would read uninitialized memory. |
| E0127 | DistinctArithmeticNotAllowed | opinion | The base arithmetic is defined, and the refusal keeps units of different distinct types from mixing. |
| E0128 | ZipLengthMismatch | opinion | Strict zip is a policy the program asked for; zipping to the shortest input would run safely. |
| E0129 | DistinctOverDistinct | opinion | A distinct type of a distinct type would run safely, and Jet refuses the layering to keep one base per type. |
| E0131 | FloatDecimalMix | opinion | A conversion between Float and Decimal is defined, and Jet asks for it written so rounding is visible. |
| E0133 | UnsupportedDecimalOperator | soundness | Decimal defines no such operator, so there is no operation to run. |
| E0134 | UnknownUnitSuffix | soundness | The suffix names no unit in scope, so the literal has no type. |
| E0135 | LiteralOutsideRange | soundness | A range type promises its bounds, and code relying on them would misbehave on a value outside. |
| E0136 | RangeValueWithoutCheck | soundness | A run-time value may be outside the range type's bounds, and code relying on them would misbehave. |
| E0137 | EmptyRangeType | opinion | A type with no values can never be built, so declaring it is harmless, and Jet refuses it as a reversed range. |
| E0138 | DistinctOperationNotGranted | opinion | The base operation is defined, and the refusal enforces the operations the distinct type chose to grant. |
| E0139 | ContractUsesEffect | soundness | A contract check is erased under proof or stripped on request, so an effect in it would make the program behave differently from build to build. |
| E0140 | SingleUseDropped | soundness | A `#SingleUse` value stands for a resource that must be consumed, and dropping it leaks or skips that step. |
| E0141 | SingleUseConsumedOnOneBranch | soundness | On the other branch the `#SingleUse` resource is never consumed, so it leaks or its step is skipped. |
| E0142 | SingleUseLent | soundness | Lending a `#SingleUse` value lets a second holder use the resource, so it could be consumed twice. |
| E0143 | SingleUseConsumeOutsideUnsafe | soundness | `consume` ends a resource without its protocol, which only an audited region may do. |
| E0144 | ResultInPrecondition | soundness | `result` does not exist before the function returns, so the precondition would read a missing value. |
| E0145 | PersistNotModuleLevel | soundness | Only module-level bindings have the storage cell that persists, so a local `#Persist` has nothing to keep. |
| E0147 | AdjacentPatternHoles | opinion | Adjacent holes could split by a fixed rule and run safely, and Jet refuses the ambiguous split. |
| E0148 | PatternTableMissingElse | soundness | A text that matches no arm leaves the table with no value. |
| E0149 | RuntimeStringAsCheckedText | soundness | A checked text type promises its text passed its check, and a raw String may not. |
| E0150 | TypestateWrongState | soundness | The operation is valid only in its state, so calling it in another uses the resource out of order. |
| E0151 | TypestateUnknownState | soundness | The named state is not one of the type's states, so no value can be in it. |
| E0152 | InvalidRegexLiteral | soundness | A Regex literal promises a pattern checked when compiling, and this one is unchecked or invalid. |
| E0153 | ProtocolExpansionFailed | soundness | The protocol's handle types failed to generate, so there are no types to check calls against. |
| E0154 | ProtocolLineMissingSender | soundness | Without a sender the line has no direction, so the generated handles cannot know who sends. |
| E0156 | PlaneLoosenedWithoutGate | soundness | Loosening a knowledge plane without its gate widens what the value is trusted with, which is capability escalation. |
| E0157 | TopLevelStateSection | soundness | A state section outside its struct has no owning type for its states. |
| E0158 | StateSectionNotAllowed | soundness | Only a struct owns a state set, so the section has no owner here. |
| E0164 | CompoundAssignToIndex | opinion | A missing key would stop with a defined panic, not a fault, and Jet asks for an explicit read and write. |
| E0165 | CompoundAssignNotPlace | soundness | A computed value has no storage, so the update has no place to write. |
| E0166 | DuplicateTypestate | soundness | A repeated state name makes the state path ambiguous. |
| E0167 | TypestateMemberConflict | soundness | States and members share one namespace, so the name would refer to two things. |
| E0168 | DuplicateStateSection | soundness | A struct has one state set, so a second section would make which states exist ambiguous. |
| E0169 | EmptyStateSection | opinion | An empty state set is harmless, and Jet refuses it because it checks nothing. |
| E0170 | RangeDirectionMismatch | opinion | A range whose ends and step count opposite ways runs zero times safely, and Jet refuses it as a likely mistake. |
| E0171 | DynMethodAsField | soundness | The name is a Dyn method, so reading it as a field would read a value that does not exist. |
| E0172 | DynWrapNotAllowed | opinion | A wrapping rule could be defined and run safely, and Jet asks for an explicit conversion for this type. |
| E0173 | DynCondition | soundness | A Dyn value has no Bool meaning, so the branch has no defined condition. |
| E0174 | TypestateMoveWithoutArrow | soundness | A state list names every move a value may make, so a move outside it would reach a state by a path the type does not allow. |
| E0175 | TypestateMarkerRetired | opinion | A retired marker's facts are written as state types, which Jet checks; the marker alone could be ignored safely, and Jet refuses it so its facts are not lost. |
| E0180 | RequiredContractNotTrue | soundness | The callee requires the condition, and running the call with it false breaks the callee's stated contract. |
| E0201 | MissingMoveMarker | soundness | Finding: one code covers a missing move mark and a move out of borrowed storage; the second would leave the owner holding a value it no longer owns, and that meaning decides the class. |
| E0204 | UseWhileWriteActive | soundness | Using the value while a write to it is active lets two accesses alias one place. |
| E0205 | FieldWriteWithoutMarker | soundness | The receiver is read-only, so callers that share it would see a write they did not allow. |
| E0208 | RawPointerOutsideUnsafe | soundness | A raw pointer can dangle or alias, so taking or reading one outside an audited region could fault memory. |
| E0209 | MoveWithoutMarker | soundness | The binding is read after this call takes it, so the later read would use moved storage. |
| E0211 | CopyNotSupported | soundness | The value has no copy operation, so a copy would duplicate a resource or a hidden reference. |
| E0212 | OwnerMovedWhileViewed | soundness | Moving or resizing the owner while a view points into it leaves the view reading freed or moved storage. |
| E0213 | WriteMarkerNotOnPlace | soundness | A window must point into stable storage, and a computed value has none. |
| E0215 | InvalidGuardMap | soundness | A mapped guard must point at a stored place under the lock, and a computed field is not one. |
| E0216 | InvalidGuardSplit | soundness | Two child guards over overlapping places would give two writers one place under one lock. |
| E0217 | CellGuardEscapes | soundness | A stored or captured Cell guard could outlive its loan and touch the cell after another borrow. |
| E0218 | PinWithoutWriteWindow | soundness | A pin promises a fixed address, and a temporary has no address that stays. |
| E0219 | PinnedPlaceMoved | soundness | Moving a pinned place leaves every stored address pointing at the old storage. |
| E0220 | ReadDuringWriteWindow | soundness | An exclusive window already writes the place, so a read beside it aliases a write. |
| E0221 | SharedReferenceCycle | soundness | Strong handles in a cycle keep each other alive, so the cycle's memory and resources are never freed. |
| E0222 | PersistentPartMoved | soundness | Persistent storage must stay whole, and a value that closes needs all its fields when it does. |
| E0223 | PersistentMutableBorrow | soundness | A mutable borrow of persistent state could escape and alias later writes to the whole binding. |
| E0225 | UnusedPlaceMark | opinion | A mark that matches no write or take changes nothing at run time, and Jet refuses it as misleading. |
| E0227 | MarkedFunctionValue | soundness | A call through the plain function type passes a read, while the function writes or takes its argument. |
| E0228 | CallMarkRequired | opinion | The call runs the same with or without the mark, and the program's own policy asks for it written. |
| E0231 | InvalidReceiverFootprint | soundness | Callers trust the stated footprint, so a footprint naming no stored field lets writes escape their checks. |
| E0301 | ImplOnBuiltinType | soundness | An `impl` on a built-in type would change what that type does in every package that uses it, so two packages could give it two meanings. |
| E0302 | UnknownField | soundness | The type declares no such field, so the read or write has no storage to reach. |
| E0303 | InvalidConstructionField | soundness | A missing, unknown or repeated field leaves a field without a value or a value without a field. |
| E0304 | UnknownEnumCase | soundness | The enum declares no such variant, so the value would carry a tag the enum does not have. |
| E0305 | PatternTypeMismatch | soundness | A pattern of another type would read the value's bytes as that type. |
| E0306 | PatternBindingCountMismatch | soundness | An extra or missing name leaves a binding without a value or a part of the value without a binding. |
| E0307 | NonExhaustiveDispatch | soundness | A value no arm covers leaves the dispatch with no code to run and no result to give. |
| E0308 | UntypedNone | soundness | Without a known `T?` type, `None` has no type or layout for the code that reads it. |
| E0309 | NestedOptional | opinion | `T??` could nest two optional layers and run safely, and Jet keeps one layer so `None` has one meaning. |
| E0310 | OptionalWhereValueExpected | soundness | Using a `T?` as a `T` would read a value that may be absent as one that is present. |
| E0311 | UnknownMethod | soundness | The receiver has no such method in the form called, so the call has no code to run. |
| E0312 | EqualityNotSupported | soundness | No equality is defined for the type, so `==` has no comparison to run. |
| E0313 | DestructureShapeMismatch | soundness | A target of another shape would bind parts the value does not have. |
| E0315 | ListPatternLengthMismatch | soundness | The list's length is known, so a pattern of another length binds positions the list does not have. |
| E0316 | InvalidRangePattern | soundness | Finding: one code covers a range on a non-integer field and an empty range; the first has no integer order to test, and that meaning decides the class. |
| E0317 | OrPatternBindingMismatch | soundness | An alternative that binds a name differently leaves the arm body reading a value that may not exist or has another type. |
| E0322 | AssignmentInCondition | soundness | An assignment is a statement and gives no Bool, so the condition has no value to branch on. |
| E0324 | AliasWithoutParameters | opinion | A transparent alias of a plain type would name the same type and run safely, and Jet keeps aliases for generic spellings so a distinct name is a `struct`. |
| E0326 | PartialDestructureWithoutRest | opinion | Leaving the unnamed fields unbound would run safely, and Jet asks for `..` so a reader sees the destructure is partial. |
| E0327 | RedundantDestructureRest | opinion | The `..` leaves out no field and changes nothing, and Jet refuses it so `..` always means fields were left out. |
| E0329 | NestedArmWithoutSubject | soundness | Without a named subject, the nested arms could belong to either table, so the dispatch has two readings. |
| E0330 | UninferableEnumCase | soundness | With no type in context, `.Variant` names no enum, so the value has no type. |
| E0331 | PayloadOnCaseGroup | soundness | A group name stands for several variants, so a payload has no one variant shape to bind. |
| E0332 | CaseGroupAsValue | soundness | A group name stands for several variants, so as a value it is no one variant. |
| E0333 | MixedComparisonChain | opinion | `a < b > c` could test each pair and run safely, and Jet refuses a chain that changes direction because it reads like a range. |
| E0335 | BlockAfterCall | opinion | The trailing block could be read as a code argument, and Jet keeps one spelling: code arguments are lambdas inside the parentheses. |
| E0336 | PatchableGenericStruct | soundness | `T.Patch` is generated from a concrete field list, and a generic struct has no one field list to generate it from. |
| E0337 | PatchableFunctionField | soundness | A patch holds owned optional values it compares and merges, and a function-typed field has no value it can compare. |
| E0338 | ComputedFieldCycle | soundness | A formula that depends on itself has no value, and evaluating it would never finish. |
| E0339 | ComputedFieldAssigned | soundness | A computed field has no storage; its value is its formula, so a write has no place to go. |
| E0343 | SwitchOffAsExpression | soundness | In a build that switches the code off, the expression would have no value. |
| E0344 | DuplicateSwitchOff | soundness | Two switch markers give one statement two conditions for emitting code, so builds could disagree on which one applies. |
| E0346 | DuplicateMetaField | opinion | `#Meta` documents code and changes none of it, and Jet refuses a repeated field so the record states one value. |
| E0347 | InvalidMetaCategory | opinion | `#Meta` documents code and changes none of it, and Jet keeps its category plain quoted text so tools can read it. |
| E0348 | EmptyMetaCategory | opinion | `#Meta` documents code and changes none of it, and Jet refuses an empty category as one that says nothing. |
| E0349 | MetaNotAllowedHere | opinion | `#Meta` documents code and changes none of it, and elsewhere it would describe no binding or function. |
| E0352 | InvalidMetaMaturity | opinion | `#Meta` documents code and changes none of it, and Jet keeps maturity to its closed scale so tools can read it. |
| E0353 | InvalidValidateRule | soundness | A `validate` block's statements are its rules, and another statement gives the validator no rule to apply. |
| E0354 | UnknownValidateField | soundness | `at:` names the field a failed check reports, and a name the struct does not declare gives the report no field. |
| E0355 | InvalidScopedPolicy | soundness | A scoped policy that widens an inherited constraint or sits at a prohibited scope would lift a rule the enclosing scope set. |
| E0356 | UninferableNewReceiver | soundness | With no expected type, `.new(...)` names no constructor to call. |
| E0357 | CasingMismatch | opinion | Casing changes no behavior, and Jet keeps one casing per category so a reader can tell types, values and constants apart. |
| E0358 | AcronymCasing | opinion | Casing changes no behavior, and Jet keeps acronyms in capitals so one name has one spelling. |
| E0359 | DimensionMismatch | soundness | A quantity's type says what its number measures, so a sum of incompatible dimensions would carry a type that is wrong for one operand. |
| E0360 | MissingOperatorHook | soundness | No hook defines the operator for this type, so there is no operation to run. |
| E0361 | RecursiveOperatorHook | soundness | The hook calls itself on every path, so each use recurses until the stack runs out. |
| E0362 | NestedHookedAssignment | soundness | A hooked compound assignment must read and write one place once, and a nested field place has no one-write form yet, so the update could be lost or applied twice. |
| E0363 | InvalidUnionMember | soundness | A union's tag picks one concrete member, and a type parameter, trait object or function type has no closed layout to tag. |
| E0364 | InclusiveIndexRange | opinion | The last step indexes one past the end, which the bounds check stops safely, and Jet refuses the range as a likely off-by-one. |
| E0365 | DuplicateUnionArm | opinion | The repeated arm can never run, so the program is defined, and Jet refuses dead arms because they hide a mistake. |
| E0366 | PatternArmWithoutEquals | soundness | Under a `<` or `!=` table an arm compares bare values, so a structural pattern has no comparison and binds nothing. |
| E0367 | BareCasePattern | opinion | The bare name could be read as the variant and run safely, and Jet asks for the dot so a pattern name is never mistaken for a binding. |
| E0368 | EmptyFence | opinion | An empty fence would expand to no statement and run safely, and Jet refuses it as a likely slip. |
| E0369 | DuplicateFenceName | soundness | Two copies under one name leave each use of the name with two meanings. |
| E0370 | FenceCountMismatch | soundness | Lock-step fences pair entries by position, so a shorter fence leaves a copy without its entry. |
| E0371 | FenceNotAllowed | soundness | Outside a binding target or complete expression statement a fence has no statement to copy, and a malformed entry has no copy to make. |
| E0372 | EffectBodyWithoutBraces | opinion | The body's meaning is clear, and Jet keeps one spelling: one statement after `->`, more inside braces. |
| E0373 | ExplicitSemicolon | opinion | The semicolon marks the boundary a line break marks, so the program is defined, and Jet keeps one spelling. |
| E0379 | GuardAfterComma | opinion | The comma changes nothing, and Jet keeps one spelling for a loop guard. |
| E0380 | LoopMissingBinding | soundness | The implicit subject names one collection item, and a scalar source or a nested loop gives it no one item to name. |
| E0382 | InvalidMemoField | soundness | `#Memo` stores a computed field's result, and anything but a bare computed field gives it no formula and dependency set to cache. |
| E0386 | AtomGroupWithoutParentheses | opinion | `\|` groups tighter, so the program is defined, and the refusal only guards against a misread grouping. |
| E0387 | CheckedTextOutsideUnsafe | soundness | `Type.raw(text)` skips the type's checker, so text that breaks the type's promise would pass as checked. |
| E0391 | UnsupportedCompileTimeValue | soundness | Only `name: #run value` is evaluated while building, so another `#run` value form has no value when the program needs it. |
| E0392 | NestedFalliblePattern | opinion | The nested pattern names the state `.Val(x)` or `.None` names and would match safely, and Jet keeps the one flat spelling. |
| E0394 | TypeAliasCycle | soundness | The alias expands to itself, so it names no type and has no layout. |
| E0395 | InvalidChannelCapacity | soundness | A channel with room for no value has no defined send, Jet has no rendezvous channel, and a capacity is never clamped. |
| E0397 | SwitchConditionMismatch | soundness | Each build condition belongs to one marker, so a mismatched pairing would leave the reader to guess whether the body runs. |
| E0398 | BitArithmeticNeedsMethod | soundness | `!` is defined only on Bool and `&=`, `\|=` and `^=` are no operators, so the code has no operation to run. |
| E0400 | InvalidMarkerGroupMember | soundness | A gate or refusal hidden in a group would apply where a reader cannot see it, so the audit of the site would miss it. |
| E0401 | FallibleWhereValueExpected | soundness | A fallible value read as its success type could be a failure report, so the code would read a value that is not there. |
| E0402 | FallibleCallIgnored | opinion | Dropping the call's result would run safely, and Jet refuses it so a failure is never lost without a trace. |
| E0403 | FailureDomainMismatch | soundness | A failure of another domain would leave the function with a report its callers cannot handle as its declared failure type. |
| E0404 | OkErrOutsideFallible | soundness | Outside a fallible context there is no success or failure slot for `ok` or `err` to fill. |
| E0405 | FallbackTypeMismatch | soundness | A fallback of another type would give one expression two types. |
| E0407 | InvalidDropReason | opinion | Dropping the value would run safely, and Jet asks for a reason so a deliberate drop is written down. |
| E0408 | ErrInOptionalFallback | soundness | An absent optional carries no failure report, so `err` would name a value that does not exist. |
| E0409 | ErrAfterPatternMiss | soundness | A pattern miss carries no failure value, so `err` would name a value that does not exist. |
| E0414 | UnknownPrivQualifier | soundness | An unknown qualifier names no visibility, so the declaration would have no reach the compiler can check. |
| E0415 | VisibilitySectionLabel | opinion | A section label could set the visibility of the items under it and run safely, and Jet refuses it because moving an item across the label would silently change its visibility. |
| E0417 | PackagePrivField | soundness | A type keeps its invariants behind its own module, so a field opened to the whole package could be written past the checks that keep them. |
| E0419 | MustUseIgnored | opinion | Dropping the result would run safely, and `#MustUse` asks every caller to use it. |
| E0420 | UninitializedRead | soundness | The read could see whatever bytes the storage held, which need not be a value of the type. |
| E0421 | UntypedUninit | soundness | An uninitialized binding has no value to infer a type from, so it would have no type or layout. |
| E0423 | UninitNotPlainData | soundness | A type that owns heap memory or needs cleanup would run its cleanup on garbage. |
| E0424 | UninitWithoutMemoryTier | soundness | `uninit` skips the zero fill, so the storage holds garbage until it is written. |
| E0429 | PreludeNameUnderNoPrelude | soundness | The file opted out of the prelude, so the name refers to nothing. |
| E0430 | ShieldWithArguments | opinion | The arguments would configure nothing and the shield would run safely, and Jet refuses them so the shield never looks configured. |
| E0433 | ValueThrownAway | opinion | Dropping the result would run safely, and Jet refuses it because a pure call whose result is dropped does nothing. |
| E0436 | MethodNamedCopyOrMove | opinion | The method would never be called, since `.copy()` and `.move()` are the compiler's own, and Jet refuses the dead name. |
| E0437 | PipeValueOutsideStep | soundness | Outside a pipe step there is no value for `<>` to name. |
| E0438 | PipeStepWithoutValue | opinion | Dropping the received value would run safely, and Jet refuses a step that never reads it as a likely slip. |
| E0439 | PipeValueTouchesAngle | opinion | The tokens have one reading, and Jet refuses the spelling because `<>` against `<` or `>` reads as another operator. |
| E0440 | EmptyTypeArgumentList | opinion | `<>` lists no type arguments and adds nothing, and Jet keeps one spelling. |
| E0501 | UntypedEmptyList | soundness | With no element type, `[]` has no layout for the code that reads its elements. |
| E0502 | InvalidMapKeyType | soundness | A key type without a stable equality and hash, such as Float or a view, would let one key find another key's entry, or none. |
| E0503 | StringIndex | soundness | An index into UTF-8 text can land inside a character, so `s[i]` has no one character to give. |
| E0504 | MixedCollectionLiteral | soundness | A collection holds one element type, so mixed items would be read as the wrong type. |
| E0505 | InvalidIndexType | soundness | An index or key of the wrong type names no position or entry in the collection. |
| E0506 | UnhashableSetElement | soundness | A set finds its elements by hash and equality, so a type without them gives the set no way to tell elements apart. |
| E0507 | CollectionChangedWhileRead | soundness | Changing the collection while the loop reads it can move or free the elements the loop is visiting. |
| E0508 | MapLiteralDuplicateKey | opinion | The literal would keep the later value and run safely, and Jet refuses the repeat so no entry is silently lost. |
| E0509 | DeferLeavesItsBlock | soundness | A `defer` body runs after its block's exit was chosen, so a second exit from it would give one block two exits. |
| E0510 | CryptoExpertNotAllowed | soundness | The raw crypto primitives skip the checks that keep keys and nonces from being reused or leaked. |
| E0511 | ExpiringForce | opinion | Reading the cached value past its expiry would run safely, and Jet refuses it so a stale value is never read as fresh. |
| E0512 | DeferPropagatesFailure | soundness | A `defer` body runs after its block's exit was chosen, so a failure passed out of it would have no exit to take. |
| E0513 | StateLoopNeverAdvances | opinion | A loop whose condition never changes would run safely until it is stopped, and Jet refuses it so a loop that cannot end is caught before it runs. |
| E0514 | MutableNeverReassigned | opinion | A `:=` name nothing writes runs exactly like a `:` name, and Jet refuses it so the binding says what the code does. |
| E0515 | DeepCheckLeavesItsBody | soundness | A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so an exit from it would make the program take a different path with and without it. |
| E0516 | DeepCheckPropagatesFailure | soundness | A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so a failure passed out of it would make the function end differently with and without it. |
| E0517 | DeepCheckChangesState | soundness | A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so a change it made to the state around it would make the program compute differently with and without it. |
| E0601 | NoTestsFound | opinion | Running no tests would finish safely, and Jet refuses it so an empty run is never taken for a passing one. |
| E0602 | UsePathEscapesProject | opinion | Code outside the project would compile and run, and Jet refuses it so a build reads only files the project holds. |
| E0603 | UseTargetNotFound | soundness | The imported file or module does not exist, so its names refer to nothing. |
| E0604 | UseCycle | soundness | Modules that import each other in a loop have no order in which each one's names are ready. |
| E0605 | PrivateItem | soundness | A module keeps its invariants behind private items and fields, and a use from outside could break them. |
| E0606 | AmbiguousModule | soundness | Two modules under one name leave the name with two meanings. |
| E0607 | ModuleFileNotFound | soundness | The declared module file does not exist, so the module has no code. |
| E0608 | UnknownInlineModuleFunction | soundness | The inline module defines no such function, so the call has no code to run. |
| E0609 | UsePrivateModuleItem | soundness | A `priv module` keeps its invariants behind its enclosing module, and a use from outside could break them. |
| E0610 | UseAliasNotModule | soundness | No module of that name is in scope, so the path refers to nothing. |
| E0611 | UseUnknownItem | soundness | The module defines no such item, so the name refers to nothing. |
| E0612 | WildcardImport | opinion | Importing every name would run safely, and Jet keeps imports explicit so each name's origin is visible. |
| E0613 | UngeneratablePropertyParameter | soundness | The runner has no way to make values of the parameter's type, so the test has no inputs to run with. |
| E0614 | UnknownScopeMember | soundness | The marker declares no such member, so the statement has no meaning in its block. |
| E0615 | ScopeMemberOutsideMarker | soundness | Outside a marker block there is no vocabulary for the member statement to name. |
| E0616 | SetupNotFirst | soundness | Code before `.setup` would run before the test's state is initialized. |
| E0617 | ScopeMemberArgumentMismatch | soundness | Each member reads exactly its declared arguments, so a missing, extra or mistyped one leaves it without the value it needs. |
| E0618 | NestedScopeMember | soundness | Each member is a top-level region of the marker block, so a nested one has no meaning. |
| E0619 | ImportDeniedByBoundary | opinion | The import would run safely, and the package's `boundaries.deny` policy refuses it to keep the declared module structure. |
| E0620 | ImportedScriptExecutes | opinion | Running the imported file's statements would be defined, and Jet refuses it so an import never gains a hidden side effect. |
| E0621 | TopLevelStatementsBesideRun | soundness | Top-level statements and `run: fn` are both an entry, so the program would have no one place to start. |
| E0622 | ModuleGlobalNotLiteral | soundness | A `#Persist` global is hot-reload state kept in a portable scalar cell, so a value that is not a scalar literal has no form the cell can carry across a reload. |
| E0623 | RelativeImportInPackage | opinion | The import would reach names the package already shares and run safely, and Jet refuses it so a package stays one namespace without file imports. |
| E0624 | DuplicatePackageName | soundness | The files of a package share one namespace, so two declarations leave the name with two meanings. |
| E0625 | RunInLibrary | soundness | A library is imported into other programs, so its `run: fn` would give an importing program a second entry. |
| E0626 | DependencyCheckFailed | soundness | The dependency has errors, so the code this package calls is not a checked program. |
| E0628 | ModuleFileItemMember | soundness | The name is the file's item, not the file, so a member reached through it refers to nothing. |
| E0629 | ModuleAsValue | soundness | A module groups declarations and has no value to bind, pass, return, store or print. |
| E0631 | ArenaViewEscapes | soundness | The view would outlive its arena and point into freed memory. |
| E0632 | ArenaViewAfterReset | soundness | `reset` frees every value in the arena, so reading the view afterward would read reused memory. |
| E0633 | IrreversibleNotAFact | soundness | The compiler reads `irreversible` without running it, so a body that is not an effect fact has no value it can read. |
| E0634 | EffectCaseWithPayload | soundness | An effect case is a name in an effect row, so a payload has no place to be stored or read. |
| E0635 | SuiteNameNotLiteral | soundness | The suite names are read without running `test: fn`, so a computed name has no value when they are listed. |
| E0636 | TypeAsValue | soundness | A type describes values but has no value to bind, pass, return, store or print. |
| E0637 | TypedLiteralInHeader | opinion | The header has one reading, with the brace opening the body, and Jet refuses the form because it looks like a typed literal. |
| E0638 | NestedFnFailureMismatch | soundness | A function held inside another value keeps the failure form it was made with, so calling it as the other form would mismatch its calling convention. |
| E0639 | SelfOutsideMethod | opinion | `self` would be an ordinary parameter and run safely, and Jet refuses it so `self` always means a method's receiver. |
| E0640 | CompileTimeReadsRuntimeValue | soundness | Compile-time code runs before any call of the function, so the run-time value it reads has no value yet. |
| E0641 | ClosedSetElse | opinion | The `else` would run safely, and Jet refuses it so a case added to the closed set later is handled on purpose. |
| E0643 | ModuleValueNotBuilt | soundness | The value must exist before `run: fn`, and one that stops or reaches the outside world while building has no value to store. |
| E0701 | MissingCrateVersion | opinion | An unpinned crate would build and run, and Jet asks for `@version` so each build uses the same crate. |
| E0702 | FfiBoundaryTypeNotAllowed | soundness | The type has no layout the foreign side agrees on, so a value crossing the boundary would be read as other bytes. |
| E0703 | MissingCargo | soundness | Without `cargo` the foreign crate is never built, so its functions have no code to call. |
| E0704 | ForeignCrateBuildFailed | soundness | The foreign crate did not build, so its functions have no code to call. |
| E0705 | ForeignSignatureMismatch | soundness | A Jet signature that differs from the foreign one would call the function with the wrong arguments or read its result as the wrong type. |
| E0711 | AuthorityHandleEscapes | soundness | `#FX` revokes the `Authority` at the end of its block, so an escaping handle would carry revoked rights past the scope. |
| E0712 | EffectWithoutAuthority | soundness | `#FX` allows exactly the effects it lists, so an effect it omits would run with no authority behind it. |
| E0713 | DeepCheckReachesEffect | soundness | A deep check runs only where `--deep-checks` keeps it, so an effect it reached would make the program act differently with and without it. |
| E0721 | TaggedValueDenied | soundness | The tag's policy denies this destination, so the value would reach a place its type forbids. |
| E0722 | CredentialValueDenied | soundness | A credential at a log, display or serialization destination would leak the secret it holds. |
| E0725 | ReplayableReachesAmbientEffect | soundness | `#Replayable` code must replay from its explicit inputs, so an ambient effect would make the same replay diverge. |
| E0731 | TagUsedAsTrait | soundness | A tag erases at runtime and carries no methods, so there is nothing to dispatch or attach. |
| E0732 | MethodInTag | soundness | A tag erases at runtime, so a method declared on it has no value to be called on. |
| E0733 | UnknownTag | soundness | No tag of that name is declared, so the value tag has no policy to enforce. |
| E0734 | InvalidTagPolicy | soundness | A tag without a complete policy has no destinations to deny, so tagged values would reach any of them. |
| E0735 | UnknownTagEndpoint | soundness | An unknown source or destination names nothing, so the policy entry would enforce nothing. |
| E0736 | ScrubSignatureMismatch | soundness | A scrubber that does not take the tagged value and return it untagged would clear a tag it never removed. |
| E0737 | FixedTimingSteer | soundness | A fixed-timing value that steers code, time or addresses leaks itself through how long the program takes. |
| E0738 | FixedTimingWideHolder | soundness | A big `Int` or a `Float` takes time that depends on its value, so a fixed-timing value held in one would leak through timing. |
| E0739 | FixedTimingCheckedArithmetic | soundness | Checked arithmetic stops when its result does not fit, so whether the program stops would leak the fixed-timing value. |
| E0740 | EffectBoundExceeded | soundness | A function's effect row is part of its type, so a body that reaches an effect the row omits would make every caller trust a false type. |
| E0742 | ImplEffectBoundExceeded | soundness | A trait method's effect bound holds for every implementation, so one that reaches more would break the bound for every caller of the trait. |
| E0743 | MissingDynamicEffectBound | soundness | A dynamic call can reach any implementation, so with no declared bound the effect ceiling around it would hold nothing. |

| E0746 | IrreversibleEffectInTransaction | soundness | A rollback undoes the block's own work, but a network, file, subprocess or foreign effect leaves outside state it cannot take back. |
| E0747 | CallbackEffectBoundExceeded | soundness | The parameter's effect row is part of its type, so a callback that reaches more would break the bound the callee relies on. |
| E0748 | InvalidViaParameter | soundness | `-[via f]>` publishes the effects of the callback `f`, so a name that is no callback parameter publishes nothing. |

| E0754 | TraitCapExceeded | soundness | A trait's `#FX` ceiling bounds every implementation, so one that reaches more would break the bound for every caller of the trait. |
| E0755 | TypeFieldCapExceeded | soundness | A method that calls the field runs its row, so a row outside the type's `#FX` cap would let the type's methods break their bound. |
| E0756 | LibraryEffectReachOutside | soundness | A library effect stands for the kernel effects listed above it, so reaching another would do more than its row says. |
| E0757 | LibraryEffectListDenial | soundness | The list above a library effect names what it relies on, so a denial there has no meaning. |
| E0758 | LibraryEffectParentInvalid | soundness | A package effect's parent chain decides which rows allow it, so a parent that is no open effect, or a cycle, leaves it allowed by no row or by every one. |
| E0759 | LibraryEffectKindOutsideRow | soundness | Another package's kind of the same effect is a different effect, so the row would allow an effect it does not name. |
| E0760 | ContextFieldWithEquals | opinion | The field's meaning is clear with either sign, and Jet keeps the one `:` spelling for `#Context` fields. |
| E0761 | UnknownContextField | soundness | `#Context` carries only its declared fields and the package's `#ContextKey` constants, so an unknown name has no slot to fill. |
| E0762 | ContextFieldTypeMismatch | soundness | The code that reads the context field takes its declared type, so a value of another type would be read as the wrong type. |
| E0763 | MisplacedParameterSeparator | soundness | A misplaced `/` or `*` leaves no one reading of which parameters take a label and which take a position. |
| E0764 | UnknownArgumentLabel | soundness | The callee has no parameter of that label, so the argument has nowhere to go. |
| E0765 | DuplicateArgumentLabel | soundness | One parameter labelled twice would receive two values. |
| E0766 | MissingArgument | soundness | A parameter with no default and no argument has no value when the body reads it. |
| E0767 | LabelOnPositionalParameter | opinion | The argument would bind to the same parameter and run safely, and Jet refuses the label so a positional-only name stays out of the call API. |
| E0768 | PositionalAfterLabel | soundness | A bare argument after a labelled one names no parameter, so it has nowhere to go. |
| E0769 | LabelOnlyPassedByPosition | opinion | The argument would bind by position and run safely, and Jet refuses it so a label-only parameter is always named at the call. |
| E0770 | DuplicateParameterLabel | soundness | Two parameters with one call label leave the second unreachable, so it could never receive an argument. |
| E0771 | FunctionValueLabelMismatch | soundness | Call labels and parameter zones are part of a function type, so a value with others would be called with arguments bound to the wrong parameters. |
| E0772 | AmbiguousCall | soundness | The arguments bind to more than one body, so the call has no one body to run. |
| E0774 | MarkerRowOutsideContract | soundness | A marker's template runs inside the compiler, so an effect outside `Marker.expand`'s row would reach the outside world while building. |
| E0775 | MarkerGeneratesOutsideRow | soundness | A template whose row lacks `Meta.Generate` is declared to only read the program, so code it writes would break its own row. |
| E0776 | CompilerValueOutsideRoot | soundness | Only the package being built makes the `Compiler` value, so a dependency calling it would take control it was never given. |
| E0801 | UnknownLambdaParameterType | soundness | A lambda parameter with no known type has no layout for the code that reads it. |
| E0802 | CallOnFunctionValue | opinion | The function value would run the same with plain parentheses; Jet keeps one spelling for a call. |
| E0803 | CalledNonFunction | soundness | The value is no function, so the call has no code to run. |
| E0804 | RecursiveLambda | soundness | The lambda would read its own binding before the binding holds it. |
| E0805 | YieldOutsideStream | soundness | Outside a `Stream<T>` function there is no stream for `yield` to give the value to. |
| E0806 | GeneratorReturnsValue | soundness | A generator gives its values through `yield`, so a value carried by `return` has nowhere to go. |
| E0807 | YieldTypeMismatch | soundness | The stream's readers take its element type, so a yielded value of another type would be read as the wrong type. |

| E0851 | ModuleAliasArgumentCount | soundness | A generic module takes exactly its declared arguments, so a missing or extra one leaves a parameter without a value or a value without a parameter. |
| E0852 | ModuleAliasBoundMismatch | soundness | The module's code relies on its bound, so a type that does not satisfy it would be used for operations it lacks. |

| E0855 | ModuleAliasCycle | soundness | A module alias that instantiates itself would never finish being built. |
| E0856 | ModuleValueParameterType | soundness | A generic module's value parameter is fixed while building, so a type that has no compile-time value has no value to fix. |
| E0857 | ModuleValueNotConstant | soundness | The module is built with its value arguments fixed, so an argument that is no closed compile-time value has no value to build with. |
| E0901 | MissingGenericBound | soundness | Without the bound, the method would call an operation the type argument may not have. |
| E0902 | OrphanImpl | soundness | An impl where neither the type nor the trait is local could clash with another package's impl, giving one pair two meanings. |
| E0904 | UninferableTypeArgument | soundness | A type argument nothing determines leaves the call with no type to build. |
| E0905 | TraitNotImplemented | soundness | The type does not implement the trait, so a call through the bound would have no method to run. |
| E0906 | MissingTraitMethod | soundness | A trait method the impl leaves out has no code to run when a caller reaches it. |
| E0907 | TraitMethodMismatch | soundness | Callers through the trait use its receiver, parameters, return type and effects, so a different signature would be called with the wrong values. |
| E0908 | DuplicateTraitImpl | soundness | Two impls of one trait for one type leave every call with two bodies. |
| E0909 | InstantiationTooDeep | soundness | An instantiation that keeps nesting would never finish being built. |
| E0910 | BreakingSchemaChange | soundness | Data stored in the published shape would be read as the new one with no migration, so its bytes would be decoded wrong. |
| E0911 | UnknownMigrationVerb | soundness | A word that is no migration verb names no change, so the migration would leave the data in an unknown shape. |
| E0913 | MissingAssociatedType | soundness | Code using the trait reads the associated type, so an impl that leaves it out gives that code no type. |
| E0914 | UnknownInterpolationSelector | soundness | An unknown selector names no format, so the interpolation has no text to produce. |
| E0915 | MissingDisplay | soundness | The type has no `Display`, so the value has no text form to print. |
| E0917 | RecursiveInlineAlways | soundness | Inlining a call to itself never ends, so the function has no fixed expansion. |
| E0918 | InlineAlwaysAddressTaken | soundness | An always-inlined function has no body of its own to point at, so its address names no code. |
| E0919 | InlineAlwaysTooLarge | opinion | Inlining the larger body would run safely, and Jet refuses it so `#Inline(Always)` keeps its size promise. |
| E0921 | MemoryDenialViolated | soundness | The rights tree denies this memory operation, so reaching it would run code with a right it was never granted. |
| E0923 | ImplOfUnknownTrait | soundness | No trait of that name is in scope, so the impl implements nothing. |
| E0926 | InvalidSchedule | soundness | An invalid schedule names no time, so the job would have no moment to run. |
| E0927 | UnknownAppliedRule | soundness | No applied rule of that name exists, so the marker would apply nothing. |
| E0928 | JobNameConflict | soundness | `jet <name>` selects one function, so two with the name leave the command with two meanings. |
| E0930 | MarkerArgumentMismatch | soundness | The marker reads its arguments as its typed signature, so others would be read as the wrong type. |
| E0931 | InvalidDeriveBang | soundness | `!` asks for a structural derive, so on another marker it names no derive to run. |
| E0932 | DeprecatedPrivateItem | opinion | `#Deprecated` on a private item would mark nothing on the public surface and run safely, and Jet refuses the empty notice. |
| E0933 | MissingTraitConstant | soundness | A trait constant without a default is read from every implementing type, so a missing one has no value to read. |
| E0934 | TraitConstantTypeMismatch | soundness | Readers take the constant as its declared type, so a value of another type would be read as the wrong type. |
| E0935 | TraitConstantNotCompileTime | soundness | A trait constant is read without running code, so a value that needs code has no value when it is read. |
| E0936 | UnknownTraitConstant | soundness | The trait declares no such constant, so nothing reads the value through the trait. |
| E0937 | AmbiguousTraitConstant | soundness | A name that names more than one constant leaves the read with two meanings. |
| E0938 | MemoNotPure | soundness | A cached call skips the body, so an impure function would lose its effects and return stale results. |
| E0939 | MemoArgumentNotHashable | soundness | The cache finds results by hashing the arguments, so an unhashable one gives it no key. |
| E0940 | MemoLazyIter | soundness | A lazy `Iter` is used up by its first reader, so a cached one would hand later callers an exhausted value. |
| E0942 | MarkersAboveAndInside | opinion | Markers in two places would apply the same set and run safely, and Jet keeps them in one place so a reader finds them together. |
| E0943 | InBodyMarkerNeedsParentheses | opinion | The marker would take the same argument and run safely, and Jet keeps one spelling: anything but a single simple value goes in parentheses. |
| E0944 | ComptimeImportAtRuntime | soundness | A `#run use` module exists only while building, so the shipped program would call a name with no code behind it. |
| E0945 | ToolchainInputOutsideTree | soundness | There is no built-in copy of the toolchain tree, so outside its own packages the read has nothing to read. |
| E0952 | ComptimeFuelExhausted | soundness | The evaluation did not finish within the build's budget, so the value it computes does not exist. |
| E0953 | ComptimePanic | soundness | The code's author marks this build as invalid with `@panic`, so there is no program to run. |
| E0955 | ComptimeFileUnreadable | soundness | The comptime input is missing or unreadable, so the value built from it does not exist. |
| E0956 | ComptimeConstructNotSupported | soundness | The evaluator cannot run the construct, so the compile-time value has nothing to compute it. |
| E0957 | InvalidEmbedPath | soundness | A path that is not a String names no file, and one outside the project would embed a file the project does not hold. |
| E0959 | MissingLayoutByteFact | soundness | The default layout leaves field order and padding to the compiler, so a byte fact read from it would name bytes that may not be there. |
| E0960 | ReservedContributionNamespace | soundness | A contribution outside the reserved namespaces names nothing the merge combines. |
| E0961 | InvalidMemberSpread | soundness | A spread entry that is not a bare name names no member to expand. |
| E0962 | RejectOutsideTemplate | soundness | Outside a marker's template there is no use site to report at, so `reject` has nothing to raise. |
| E0963 | InvalidFixedListLength | soundness | A fixed list's length is part of its type and layout, so one unknown or out of range while building gives it neither. |
| E0964 | FixedListLengthChange | soundness | A fixed list's length is part of its type and storage, so a change at run time would read or write past the storage. |
| E0965 | FixedListIndexOutOfRange | opinion | The bounds check would stop the out-of-range index safely at run time, and Jet reports it early because the build already proves it. |
| E0966 | InvalidModuleContribution | soundness | The merge reads a contribution as its namespace's type, so another value would be combined as the wrong type. |
| E0967 | ModuleSourceConflict | soundness | Sources merge by name, so two refs under one name leave it with two meanings. |
| E0968 | InvalidModuleSource | soundness | A source that is no `target@provider` ref or bare path names nothing to fetch. |
| E0969 | InvalidImportsDiscovery | soundness | Discovery reads one literal `find` path, so any other directive names no directory to walk. |
| E0970 | ImportsDirectoryNotFound | soundness | The directory does not exist, so discovery has no modules to find. |
| E0971 | NestedDiscoveredImports | opinion | A nested discovery could still be merged, and Jet refuses it so modules only contribute to the whole and never import each other. |
| E0972 | UnknownSystemField | soundness | The record defines no such field, so the value has nowhere to go. |
| E0973 | UnknownPlatform | soundness | Jet knows no such platform, so the build has no target to compile for. |
| E0974 | MissingSystemTarget | soundness | A `System` with no `target` has no platform to build for. |
| E0975 | InvalidServiceEnable | soundness | A `Service` with no yes/no `enable` leaves it unknown whether the service runs. |
| E0976 | FrozenImageFormat | soundness | Jetpack builds no frozen disk-image format, so the image has no builder. |
| E0977 | InvalidImageFrom | soundness | An image with no active `from` has no base to build from, and a restated frozen field has no active meaning. |
| E0978 | UnknownImageSystem | soundness | The referenced system is frozen or unknown, so the image has no active base. |
| E0979 | MissingOsHost | soundness | A target with no host, or with an empty half of `host@root`, selects no system. |
| E0980 | UnknownOsHost | soundness | The config defines no system of that name, so the host selects nothing. |
| E0981 | OsConfigNotFound | soundness | The config file does not exist, so there is no system to build. |
| E0986 | DetachedCallableMarker | soundness | A detached `->`, effect row, `::` or brace leaves no one reading of where the declaration head ends. |
| E0987 | UnknownLoopLabel | soundness | No enclosing loop has that name, so the jump has no target. |
| E0988 | LoopLabelAsValue | soundness | A loop name is a compile-time jump target and has no value to read. |
| E0989 | CompileTimeIfNotConstant | soundness | `@if` picks its branch while building, so a condition with no compile-time value picks none. |
| E0992 | DispatchMissingComparison | soundness | Without a comparison the body is statements, so the arms written as values have no meaning. |
| E0994 | RedundantArmComparison | opinion | The arm would compare the same way and run safely, and Jet refuses the repeated comparison so each arm states only its value. |
| E0995 | MissingWorkspaceModule | soundness | With no `workspace` module the workspace has no member list, so there is nothing to build. |

| E0997 | MembersDirectoryNotFound | soundness | The directory does not exist, so the scan finds no member packages. |
| E0998 | InvalidOverlayPolicy | soundness | A malformed overlay policy states no rule, so the workspace would build under one nobody wrote. |
| E0999 | StackedRuleLines | opinion | Stacked rule lines would apply the same rules and run safely, and Jet keeps one list spelling. |
| E1001 | UnknownCoreModule | soundness | No core module of that name exists for this code, and a `core.<area>.runtime` unit holds Core's private invariants, so the import refers to nothing it may use. |
| E1002 | ReservedRootShadowed | soundness | The reserved root names a package Jet provides, so a local module under it gives the name two meanings. |

| E1004 | UnknownCoreItem | soundness | The core module defines no such item, so the name refers to nothing. |

| E1102 | ValueNotSendable | soundness | A view, trait value, mutable capture, borrowed closure or thread-confined cell that crosses to another worker would be used by two at once or outlive its source. |

| E1202 | StaleLockFile | opinion | Resolving again would build and run safely, and Jet refuses a stale lock so a build uses exactly the inputs it locked. |

| E1253 | UnresolvedInlineDependency | soundness | The inline dependency has no local copy, so its names have no code. |

| E1271 | UnlockedSourceChannel | soundness | Builds never re-resolve channels, so a channel with no lock entry has no exact source. |

| E1274 | MissingStoreRecord | soundness | There is no package record or build attempt on this machine, so there is nothing to explain. |

| E1280 | MissingKernelPackage | soundness | The generation has no kernel package, so it has nothing to boot. |
| E1281 | MissingInitPackage | soundness | The generation has no init package, so the booted system has nothing to start. |
| E1282 | MissingBootArtifacts | soundness | The kernel package has no bootable image and initrd, so the generation cannot boot. |

| E1285 | VmProofNotRun | soundness | Nothing has proved that the system installs and boots, so using it would trust an unproved generation. |
| E1286 | KernelBuildFailed | soundness | The kernel's source build failed, so the generation has no boot artifacts. |
| E1287 | MissingInstalledDisk | soundness | There is no proved installed disk, so the VM would open a disk nothing has verified. |
| E1288 | MissingDesktopPackage | soundness | The generation has no desktop package, so the default desktop profile has nothing to start. |

| E1292 | MissingRandomness | soundness | Without cryptographic randomness a signing key would be guessable. |

| E1295 | UnknownGitRef | soundness | The git ref resolves to no commit, so there is no baseline to diff against. |
| E1297 | ToolJobConflict | soundness | The tool and the job would both answer to one name on `~/.jet/bin`, so the name would have two meanings. |

| E1324 | DuplicateMemberDirectory | soundness | Two spellings of one directory would make two Package identities for one package. |
| E1325 | DuplicateMemberPackage | soundness | Two members with one Package name give that name two owners. |
| E1326 | InvalidEnvironmentFile | soundness | An unsafe path or ambiguous ownership would let a managed file overwrite something no one declared. |
| E1327 | UnknownEnvironment | soundness | The image names no declared environment, so it has nothing to project. |
| E1328 | InvalidReadinessProbe | soundness | An invalid probe cannot tell whether the service is ready, so code that waits on it would start against a service in an unknown state. |
| E1329 | UntrustedLifecycleHook | soundness | A lifecycle hook runs project commands during activation, so running an untrusted one runs commands nobody reviewed. |
| E1330 | InvalidTaskMetadata | soundness | Task inputs, outputs and paths must be deterministic and inside the project, or a cached result could stand for different work or touch files outside it. |
| E1331 | EnvironmentImportEscapes | opinion | Importing a file outside the project would work, and Jet keeps one environment graph inside its project boundary. |
| E1332 | EnvironmentDefinitionConflict | soundness | Two definitions conflict, so composing them has no one result. |

| E1334 | InvalidWorkspaceMember | soundness | A directory with no Package manifest is no package, so the member has no identity. |
| E1335 | EnvironmentIntegrationConflict | soundness | A conflicting or lossy integration, or a path outside the lease, would hand the child an output nobody verified. |
| E1336 | ImageProjectionFailed | soundness | Image layers come only from verified output and declared safe files, so this layer has no verified source. |
| E1337 | UnknownEnvironmentModule | soundness | No `env.<name>` module of that name is declared, so there is no environment to activate. |
| E1338 | LibraryIdentityMismatch | soundness | Jet makes no binary layout promise across versions, so loading the library could read its data with the wrong layout. |
| E1339 | LibraryEffectNotGranted | soundness | The library asks for an effect the load site does not grant, so loading it would give it authority the host refused. |
| E1340 | JetpackCommandFailed | soundness | An input, fact, tool or system operation the command needs failed, so the command has no result. |
| E1341 | InvalidLibraryOutput | soundness | The requested target, binding, ABI or export shape has no checked native projection. |
| E1344 | CliCommandConflict | soundness | A word that names two commands, or a command and a root flag, has two meanings on the command line. |
| E1345 | CliMemberNotCallable | soundness | The member has no shape the command dispatcher can call. |
| E1346 | CliMembersOnCodable | opinion | The commands could be dispatched, and Jet keeps a Codable struct to serializable data so behavior lives elsewhere. |
| E1347 | WritableCliReceiver | soundness | Dispatch holds the parsed program value read-only, so a writable receiver would write through a value it may not change. |
| E1348 | UntrustedNixpkgsIndex | soundness | The signed index failed verification, so a package selected from it would be one nobody vouched for. |
| E1349 | NixpkgsAttrNotIndexed | soundness | The signed index cannot prove this attr, so there is no verified package for it. |
| E1350 | NixCacheAdmissionFailed | soundness | The cache closure failed a check, so admitting it would bring in bytes nobody verified. |
| E1351 | NixExecutionUnavailable | soundness | The isolated store projection could not be made, so the closure has nowhere safe to run. |
| E1352 | PinnedSourceUpdate | opinion | Moving the lock would build and run safely, and Jet keeps a source without a channel marker pinned so only a marker moves it. |
| E1355 | OutsideProjectEnvironment | soundness | The command needs the project's verified environment, so outside it the tools and inputs are not the declared ones. |
| E1358 | InvalidRef | soundness | The text is no package ref, so it names no package. |

| E1411 | InvalidDevtoolsPanel | soundness | A panel that does not match the `panel(state: State) UiNode` contract cannot be called by the devtools host. |

| E2512 | MatrixShapeMismatch | soundness | The inner sides of the product differ, so the multiplication has no defined result. |
