| E3107 | MissingUnsafeObligation | soundness | The policy requires a typed proof after each low-level operation, so without it the operation has no proof. |
| E3108 | InvalidUnsafeOption | soundness | Unsafe proof vocabulary is closed, so an unknown option proves nothing. |
| E3109 | InvalidGatePolicy | soundness | Admin policy never fails open, so an unreadable or malformed policy cannot grant anything. |
| E3110 | InvalidSwizzleLane | soundness | The type has no such lane, so the swizzle would read or write past its lanes. |
| E3111 | DuplicateSwizzleLane | soundness | A write swizzle that repeats a lane writes it twice, so the result has no one meaning. |
| E3112 | MissingUnsafeReason | opinion | The region would run the same with no reason, and Jet makes the audit sentence mandatory so a reviewer reads why it is safe. |
| E3201 | CLibraryNotFound | soundness | No dependency or system package provides the library, so its names have no code. |
| E3202 | PointerAcrossCBoundary | soundness | A pointer or gated type crossing to C escapes memory checks, so it needs an audited region. |
| E3203 | NonCAbiType | soundness | The type has no stable C ABI, so the foreign function would read or write it with the wrong layout. |
| E3204 | DuplicateCLibraryUse | opinion | Both forms would bind the same library, and Jet keeps one bring-in per library per file. |
| E3205 | OverlayBindingConflict | soundness | The overlay's Jet signature disagrees with the C symbol it replaces, so calls would pass the wrong types. |
| E3206 | ReservedBindgenSegment | soundness | The `__bindgen__` segment is where generated bindings live, so a user module there gives the path two owners. |
| E3207 | BindgenOutsideGenerated | soundness | `#Bindgen` signatures are trusted as generated from the header, so hand-written ones would be trusted without that check. |
| E3208 | BindingGenerationFailed | soundness | The header produced no bindings, so the library's names have no Jet signatures. |
| E3209 | CLibraryNotLinked | soundness | The linker cannot find the library, so its symbols have no code. |
| E3210 | CLibraryProvisionFailed | soundness | Provisioning the library failed, so its names have no code. |
| E3211 | InteriorNulByte | soundness | C strings end at NUL, so an embedded NUL would silently truncate the string on the C side. |
| E3212 | UnknownCallingConvention | soundness | The calling convention is not a ratified ABI, so calls would pass arguments in no defined way. |
| E3213 | CallingConventionNotOnTarget | soundness | The calling convention does not exist on this target, so calls would pass arguments in no defined way. |
| E3214 | VariadicCallingConvention | soundness | The convention defines no variadic argument passing, so variadic calls would pass arguments in no defined way. |
| E3215 | InlineForeignOutsideUnsafe | soundness | Inline C, C++ or asm can violate memory safety, so outside an audited region nobody vouches for it. |
| E3216 | InvalidForeignBoundaryEvidence | soundness | The foreign boundary evidence is invalid, so nothing shows the boundary is safe to cross. |
| E3217 | CBindingMemberMissing | soundness | No binding declares the member, so the name has no foreign symbol. |
| E3218 | CallbackReadsContext | soundness | C calls the callback on a thread it chooses, where no Jet task runs, so the read would find no task context. |
| E3220 | UnsupportedForeignLanguage | soundness | The language has no inline foreign binder, so the body has no code. |
| E3221 | AsmUnencodedMnemonic | soundness | The template assembler has no encoding for the mnemonic, so the line has no bytes to emit. |
| E3222 | InlineForeignBuildFailed | soundness | The foreign bridge did not compile or link, so the function has no code. |
| E3223 | AsmOperandMismatch | soundness | The asm operands do not match the Jet signature, so values would land in the wrong registers. |
| E3260 | ComWithoutWindows | soundness | COM is a Windows facility, so on another host there is nothing to call. |
| E3261 | InvalidCImportBody | soundness | An `#Import(c)` function binds a C symbol, so a Jet body leaves it bound to nothing. |
| E3301 | OsApiOnNoOsTarget | soundness | A no-OS target has no operating system, so the API has nothing to call. |
| E3302 | UnknownTarget | soundness | Jet has no backend for the target, so there is nothing to build with. |
| E3303 | MissingAllocatorFact | soundness | A no-OS target has no system heap, so allocation has no memory to take. |
| E3304 | SocketModuleNotOnTarget | soundness | The target has no socket runtime, so the module has nothing to call. |
| E3305 | SocketOperationNotOnTarget | soundness | The target has no adapter for the operation, so the call has nothing to run. |
| E3310 | RuntimeLayerNotOnTarget | soundness | The target provides a lower runtime layer than the Prelude part needs, so the part has no runtime. |
| E3311 | MissingTargetCapability | soundness | The target profile does not state the capability, so the program would reach a machine service that may not exist. |
| E3312 | InvalidProviderDigest | soundness | A provider without a valid digest has no stable identity, so artifacts could reuse changed behavior. |
| E3313 | MmioFactViolation | soundness | An MMIO access outside a declared region, or without a reason, could write anywhere in device memory. |
| E3314 | InvalidTargetFact | soundness | Target facts are explicit inputs to sema, so an invalid one leaves memory, startup or execution undefined. |
| E3401 | ImpureCallInPureContext | soundness | A pure function's effect row is part of its type, so an impure call would break it. |
| E3402 | AmbientIoInPackageBuild | soundness | Package builds run without ambient I/O, so the call would reach outside the sandbox. |
| E3403 | NondeterminismInPureEval | soundness | Pure evaluation must give one result on every machine, so non-determinism breaks it. |
| E3405 | DebugTraceInRelease | opinion | The trace would print and change nothing else, and Jet keeps development traces out of shipped artifacts. |
| E3410 | ComptimeEffectWithoutImpure | soundness | The call touches the host at compile time, so without the gate a build would read state no cache or sandbox tracks. |
| E3411 | ImpureGateNotAllowed | soundness | The invocation gate is how a run consents to host I/O, so without it the build reads the host unaudited. |
| E3412 | ComptimeNetUnavailable | soundness | Only hash-pinned `fetch` is hermetic at compile time, so another network call would make the build depend on the network. |
| E3413 | FetchHashMismatch | soundness | The content does not match its pin, so it is not the bytes the build promised. |
| E3414 | FetchFailed | soundness | The fetch failed, so there is no content to embed. |
| E3415 | GateDeniedByPolicy | soundness | An organization or package `.Forbid` is authoritative, so a narrower allowance cannot widen it. |
| E3502 | BuildPlanFailed | soundness | The build plan is invalid, so there is no deterministic graph to run. |
| E3503 | BuildAuthorityDenied | soundness | The root build asks for authority one of its three checks does not grant. |
| E3504 | BuildActionAuthorityDenied | soundness | The build action asks for authority nobody granted. |
| E3505 | BuildProbeFailed | soundness | The probe or sandboxed action failed, and Jet never falls back to ambient execution, so there is no result. |
| E3510 | GeneratedModuleShadows | soundness | The generated module would replace written source, so what compiles would not be what was written. |
| E3511 | GenerationCycle | soundness | Two producers for one module would make what compiles depend on which ran last. |
| E3512 | LockedGenerationDrift | soundness | The generated input changed from the lock, so a `--locked` build would compile bytes nobody locked. |
| E3513 | LockedEffectRowWidened | soundness | The dependency now reaches an effect the lock does not record, so a `--locked` build would grant authority nobody reviewed. |
| E3514 | RewriteWithoutConsent | soundness | Rewriting a dependency's code changes what runs, so it needs the root's consent. |
| E3515 | MissingProducer | soundness | No producer makes the file, so it is stale or was never made, and nothing checks it. |
| E3520 | DuplicateBuildEntry | soundness | Two build entries give one package two build authorities. |
| E3521 | BuildFactConflict | soundness | Two writers at one layer disagree, so the fact has no one value. |
| E3530 | ReservedBuildRuleCode | soundness | Compiler codes own that shape, so a build rule code there gives the code two meanings. |
| E3540 | DuplicateCommandOverride | soundness | Several overrides for one command leave it with no one behavior. |
| E3611 | CorruptProofArtifact | soundness | The proof artifact's hash or bytes do not match, so it proves nothing. |
| E3614 | UnsafeProofArtifactPath | soundness | A symlinked or unsafe path could redirect the artifact's write somewhere else. |
| E3620 | ReplaySchemaMismatch | soundness | This `jet prove` cannot read the replay schema, so it has no defined replay. |
| E3621 | ReplayIdentityMismatch | soundness | The replay belongs to other source, toolchain or adapter, so it proves nothing about this target. |
| E3622 | CorruptReplay | soundness | The replay artifact failed verification, so it proves nothing. |
| E3623 | ReplayDiverged | soundness | The run diverged from the captured authority, so the replay no longer shows what the program does. |
| E3624 | ReplayTargetNotUnique | soundness | Capture or replay selected no target or several, so it has no one program. |
| E3625 | UnmodeledReplayOperation | soundness | The operation has no bounded replay adapter, so the capture would miss what it did. |
| E3627 | ReplaySensitiveData | soundness | The capture would record sensitive data nobody consented to store. |
| E3628 | ReplayTooLarge | soundness | The replay exceeded its bounded budget or recorded no authority, so there is no usable artifact. |
| E3629 | ReplayFinalizeFailed | soundness | The write was refused, so no durable artifact exists. |
| E4201 | TlsHandshakeFailed | soundness | The connection never became secure, so data sent over it would travel unprotected. |
| E4202 | UntrustedCertificate | soundness | The certificate cannot be verified for the host, so the server could be anyone. |
| E4203 | MissingCertificateRoots | soundness | With no root set no certificate can be verified, so no HTTPS connection can be trusted. |
| JT0198 | SourceImportFailed | soundness | The import operation failed, so there is no imported source. |
| JT0199 | SourceImportConflict | soundness | Both the generated and the edited source changed, so writing either would discard the other's edits. |
| L1101 | UndischargedTask | soundness | The program may end before the task finishes, so its work and the resources it holds are lost unseen. |
| R0801 | RawAccessOutsideProvenance | soundness | The raw access lies outside the gate's allocation, so it would read or write memory the program does not own. |
| R0802 | UseAfterLifetime | soundness | The storage's lifetime ended, so the access would read or write freed memory. |
| R0803 | MisalignedRawAccess | soundness | A misaligned raw access has no defined result on the machine. |
